$comment: Declarative repo governance. This file is the DECLARATION of intended state; it is not itself the applier. Do NOT run scripts/sync-repo-governance.sh to change required checks — prismalens/prismalens#301 documents that its ruleset lookup can fail OPEN and create a second overlapping ruleset. Apply ruleset changes with `gh api` directly, taking a JSON backup first and reading the live ruleset back afterwards; keep this file matching what you applied so a later sync cannot drift it out. Deltas on top of the original live-state snapshot: (1) 'Validate PR title (conventional commits)' is a REQUIRED status check; (2) 'review-evidence' is a REQUIRED status check, applied by hand via gh api against ruleset 18200324 — see prismalens/prismalens#301; (3) labels 'coderabbit_review' and 'cr:queue' back the CodeRabbit label-admission valve. Everything else applies as a no-op, so any further diff is an intentional change.
